race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
race.verdict: GO GO GIRL looks to have plenty in her favour, and she's fancied to make a winning start in nurseries. Lord Ragnar is feared most back in calmer waters, with Big Hitter , Roosike and Time Teller also respected. GO GO GIRL LORD RAGNAR (IRE) BIG HITTER (IRE)
